conclusion.interpretation: Physical CANCEL and downstream disengagement are observed. No direct literal bit transition or new contiguous 1..16-bit enum value reproduces in every retained ADAS-side event under the declared screens. No command is inferred from correlations, read-only DIDs, or legacy Toyota CAN layouts.
conclusion.not_excluded: multibit or multiplexed encodings, sparse traffic outside these windows, a cancellation command not exercised by physical-switch cancellation, or an unacquired receiver implementation
conclusion.runtime_change: none; stock-harness 0x101/0xFE remain on the unsplit chassis network, so the prior wrong-relay brake spoof is not restored

enumerated_value_screen.boundary: does not exclude a command unexercised by physical CANCEL, noncontiguous encodings, context-dependent values, or an unobserved input path
enumerated_value_screen.scope: every contiguous 1..16-bit field after B2, big/MSB-first and little/LSB-first; intersection of post-minus-pre value sets over all 21 events

gts_surface.boundary: absence of a named GTS active test is not proof that ECU firmware has no cancellation command
gts_surface.monitor_oracle: DID 0x1B01 groups ISA main-switch recognition with output set-cancel/cancel/resume switch monitors. These read-only observations are not a DRCC CAN field map or an actuator API
gts_surface.named_test_disposition: PDA Cancel Notification Display is a display active test, not an adaptive-cruise cancellation command

literal_edge_screen.after: 0..1000 ms; includes possible state echoes after cruise disengages
literal_edge_screen.before: -1000..-25 ms relative to physical CANCEL assertion
literal_edge_screen.fields: each bit after CRC/counter prefix B0..B2, both polarities, every retained ADAS stream

multibit_pulse_screen.criterion: a common value absent from every pre-window and present at least once in every post-window

source_layout: historical repin: switch/brake bus0; native cruise state bus2; ADAS sideband bus1
